text: The new Isolde-class ferry can carry 1,800 passengers, the Seabridge Port Authority said Tuesday as it took delivery of the vessel at North Quay. The 143-metre ferry, named the Aster Vale, will begin trial sailings next week before entering regular service on the Midharbour route in early June. Port officials said the ship also has space for 320 cars and uses a lower-emission hybrid drive system. Authority chair Lina Merrow said the vessel will improve peak-hour capacity and cut queuing at the terminal. The Aster Vale is the first of two Isolde-class ferries ordered by the authority in 2023, with the second due to arrive later this year.
